root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: deprivation of beneficial provision, especially through drought, and hostile pursuit or advocacy involving a charge against someone.
root_idea.development: The deprivation branch appears in drought, barren land, rainless stars, and spoiled milk. A separate interpersonal branch concerns pursuing someone with an accusation, while also extending to arguing in someone's defense. The Quranic مِحَال is interpreted either through punitive seizure or through power and strategic capacity.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quran-attested verbal noun, normalized from the genitive Quran occurrence مِحَالِ to the citation form مِحَالٌ.

senses.definition: Punitive seizure: taking someone with punishment or intending harm against him.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic expression شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ, where it describes formidable punitive action directed against wrongdoers.

senses.definition: Power, force, or effective capacity to act, including strategic ability.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ derives the word from حَوْل and حِيلَة; this is an interpretation of the same Quranic occurrence, not a separate occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drought; cessation of rain and drying of the earth so that herbage is lacking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same deprivation branch describes a barren time, place, or land in related forms such as مَاحِلٌ and أَمْحَلَتِ الْأَرْضُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the stars: to set at dawn without bringing rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction specifically predicated of the stars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To labor and employ skill, craft, or management in seeking to acquire property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied evidence includes acquisition without paying a price as one formulation, but that circumstance is not required by the broader meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vertebra or segment of the backbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is reported as المَحَالّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk that has spoiled or turned after fresh milk is repeatedly milked onto it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of milk in the supplied lexical expression لَبَنٌ مُمَحَّلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue a charge against someone, carry tales against him, or denounce him to an authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attested construction includes directing the accusation to a ruler or other authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To argue or plead in defense of someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct oppositional use meaning to dispute or advocate on another's behalf.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The rainless setting of the stars is represented as a specific Form IV construction.
Laboring and using management to acquire property is represented.
Drought and earth deprived of herbage are represented.

cautions: The two Quranic senses of مِحَالٌ are alternative interpretations of its single supplied occurrence in 13:13; the contextual gloss “(in) Strength” does not by itself resolve the lexical interpretation.
